provenance: Independently authored complete 28-scene EyezOn thank-you film: Canvas Bezier handles/point, staggered digits, square/triangle/eye morph, sampled dot-matrix 100, 100 isometric tiles/17 rising columns, five-arm 100-point orbit with fixed-seed trails, ring lettering, vector eye emblem and final brand. No source image/video/full-frame sequence loaded. Original audio comparison only.
editable: project.json palette, chronology and marks;composition.js dedicated geometry and time functions.
differences: Substitute Anton/Tinos/JetBrains OFL typefaces, including measured horizontal scaling and italic shear; original glyph outlines and blur remain different.
Digit easing/trails, morph boundary interpolation, eye outline and transform handle trails differ in detail.
100 tile floor and 17 independent rising columns use measured isometric geometry; heights, exact cells, depth overlap and moving light differ.
Five-arm 100-point golden particle orbit plus 1250 independent seeded trail particles are authored; camera projection, particle distribution, blur and exact angular phase differ.
Brand emblem is an independently drawn vector interpretation; text ring motion blur and angular spacing, footer typography and colors differ.
Source soundtrack is retained solely for reference comparison; no independently authored soundtrack.
